# Data Integrity Checklist: SPEC-014 Control-Flow Graphs

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-014 data integrity requirements are complete, precise, consistent, and measurable before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-07-25
**Feature**: ../spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Schema And Persistence

- [x] CHK001 Are CFG status, block, edge, source-version, and contract-version fields documented for durable SQLite storage? [Completeness, Spec FR-004, Spec FR-015, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK002 Are schema ownership boundaries clear that CFG status stores function identity by value and has no foreign key to general `nodes(id)`? [Clarity, Spec FR-004, Plan Persistence and Lifecycle, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK003 Are CFG-owned cascade relationships limited to status, block, and edge tables rather than general graph rows? [Consistency, Spec FR-004, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK004 Are row-local constraints, same-function edge references, uniqueness expectations, and required indexes specified for the CFG SQLite tables? [Completeness, data-model.md SQLite Schema Constraints and Indexes]
- [x] CHK005 Are migration requirements tied to real SQLite and fresh-schema parity rather than mock storage? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Plan Technical Context, data-model.md SQLite Schema Constraints and Indexes]

## Source Versions And Freshness

- [x] CHK006 Is the per-function `sourceVersion` defined as an opaque function snapshot token rather than a project-wide graph write version? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, Plan Source and Contract Versions]
- [x] CHK007 Are current, stale, missing, deleted, and unknown-function read states derivable from live config, indexed function existence, source-version equality, contract versions, and row availability? [Completeness, Spec FR-005, Spec FR-015, Plan Phase 0 Research Output]
- [x] CHK008 Are retained rows prevented from appearing fresh when the function token or CFG contract versions differ? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Spec FR-015, Plan Source and Contract Versions]
- [x] CHK009 Is it explicit that unrelated project writes must not make an unchanged function stale? [Measurability, Spec FR-015]

## Lifecycle Transitions

- [x] CHK010 Are first-enable requirements complete, including full backfill when the ordinary incremental change set is empty? [Completeness, Spec FR-003, data-model.md State Transitions]
- [x] CHK011 Is affected-file replacement required to compute all current function statuses before one transaction replaces prior status, block, and edge rows? [Clarity, Spec FR-004, Plan Persistence and Lifecycle, data-model.md]
- [x] CHK012 Are source-file deletion and function deletion requirements complete enough to remove payloads while retaining compact deleted tombstones? [Completeness, Spec FR-005, data-model.md State Transitions]
- [x] CHK013 Are disabled and re-enabled transition requirements clear that retained rows are inert while disabled and must be refreshed before serving as current? [Consistency, Spec FR-006, Spec FR-007, data-model.md State Transitions]

## Failure And Replacement Semantics

- [x] CHK014 Are unexpected first-refresh and later-refresh failure states differentiated by payload retention and stable reasons? [Clarity, Spec FR-008, Spec FR-009, data-model.md State Transitions]
- [x] CHK015 Is stale snapshot retention limited to unexpected refresh/version mismatch cases, with unsupported or resource-limited refreshes replacing prior payloads instead? [Consistency, Spec FR-016, Spec FR-017, data-model.md State Transitions]
- [x] CHK016 Are unsupported, parse-unsafe, parser-unavailable, and resource-limited outcomes specified as whole-function skips with no block or edge payload rows? [Completeness, Spec FR-016, Spec FR-017, data-model.md Validation rules]
- [x] CHK017 Are cancellation requirements precise enough to forbid partial writes before swap while preserving committed results after swap? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Spec FR-009, Plan Performance and Reliability, data-model.md State Transitions]

## Verification Evidence

- [x] CHK018 Are real-SQLite lifecycle verification requirements documented for enable, backfill, affected-file refresh, delete, disable, stale failure, first failure, cancellation, and re-enable? [Coverage, Spec SC-004, Plan Slice 1 Verification Gates]
- [x] CHK019 Are success criteria measurable for zero disabled writes, stable skip states, no partial CFG payloads, and stale/deleted/non-computed state assertions? [Measurability, Spec SC-001, Spec SC-002, Spec SC-004, Spec SC-005]
- [x] CHK020 Does the plan identify the implementation files that must carry schema, migration, lifecycle, and status-store ownership without broadening unrelated storage behavior? [Traceability, Plan Declared File Operations, Plan Slice 1]
